en: Sepia-toned street view of a European town showing an ornate corner building with a clock tower on the left, a bridge with metal railings in the foreground over a stone-lined waterway, and a straight street lined with multi‑story buildings leading toward a church tower in the background. People are faintly visible along the street and shopfronts. The top of the image bears printed captions indicating the town and street name.
